verdict.rationale: Fellow documents that every conversation is searchable through a full transcript, and that recordings carry timestamped transcripts. Its MCP server lets users ask questions across their meetings. However, nothing documents one unified search across transcripts, summaries and notes, or the ability to jump to the exact moment something was said. Missing for 10: documented cross-meeting search spanning summaries and notes, jump-to-timestamp playback from search results, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can search across every past meeting — transcripts, summaries, and notes — and jump to the exact moment something was said

citations.quote: Every conversation becomes searchable through a full transcript, giving your team instant access to past context whenever they need it.
Ask anything about your meetings - Get answers to questions like "What were my action items this week?" or "What did we decide in last month's standup?"
